snippet.title: Opening Cutscene - Fin Fin: TanTan TEO
snippet.description:
TanTan TEO download: http://www.finfin-archiv.de/software-programme.htm
(i am not responsible for the content of this website!)

TanTan TEO OST playlist: https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PL4fCDLZEfDpYINyBu5hdl2Ae30ZWB8Z7s&si=2UyODlaDCWM31HCG

"TanTan TEO" was created by Fujitsu Interactive, Inc. for Microsoft Windows in 1998 as a spinoff for "Fin Fin on Teo, the Magic Planet". In the game, Fin Fin would like to participate in a music festival, but he must first improve his rhythm with the help of his friends. It is a music game in which the player controls Fin Fin with two keys and has to reach a certain amount of correct key combinations in the time limit in order to pass a level.
